From the "Girl's Art Museum - Staff" series

---

The island commonly known as “Ayagashima” is home to the Girl art museum. Even in this place, where the rules of the outside world do not apply, there is an organization similar to the police. They are called “security guards” and are responsible for maintaining public order throughout the island.

The most striking feature, without a doubt, is that their uniforms are painted directly onto their bodies. Everything except their hats, shoes, and earpieces is painted on. Of course, even the socks—which should be hidden by their shoes—are meticulously painted.

Although they use ink that is relatively water-resistant, it still runs if they sweat heavily. While having to repaint every day makes it incredibly inconvenient, it’s a look that suits the security guards on this island.
The security staff consists entirely of women, and they are responsible for maintaining order and surveillance on the island, as well as guiding visitors. Of course, serving the visitors is also part of their job.

While they essentially function as sex slaves, they do possess certain authority, such as inspecting suspicious individuals and arresting criminals.
However, as long as you aren’t a criminal, they’re just like loyal dogs. You might sense a slightly intimidating aura about them, but deep down, they’re nothing more than horny female dogs who love nothing more than getting it on.
Except when they’re on the run or chasing a criminal (which, of course, rarely happens), they must always serve visitors whenever requested.
And they cannot stop working even while serving. Even if they are being violated, they must continue compiling reports or maintaining radio communication.

There are other strict rules they must follow while on duty, such as not showing any emotion on their faces or suppressing their moans.
Despite their appearance, these women are actually elite former members of the police, special forces, and the military. Since our facility has connections with these organizations, we have handpicked the most beautiful women to form a security unit.

They do not wear collars like our staff members, but that is because they have undergone advanced brainwashing procedures. By implanting a small chip in their heads, we have made them swear absolute loyalty while preserving their original personalities.
However, this technology is still in the prototype stage and faces many challenges. In particular, the side effect of sudden, explosive surges in sexual desire is somewhat troublesome. Please be very careful if any of them request a suspicious “personal search” of you.
